subject: Probably tomorrow morning
author: ZombieTron
body:
I wouldn't bother staying up just in case it's earlier... I don't think any of the previous DLC was released at 0.00 hours on the day of release.

In fact if anything it's not normally available til about lunch time if my memory serves me well, which it rarely does.

Either way I wont be trying to get it til tomorrow afternoon thanks to a hospital appointment in the morning which is due to take about 3 hours, and then we will only have 1 Xbox 360 between me and Xandu until Friday - which is hopefully when my removals are being delivered. So, we will be fighting over the controller til then! 🙂
